fact_sources.fact: Malaysia's Immigration Department notice dated 17 Nov 2026: Indians need a visa before arrival from 1 Jan 2027; visa-free entry ends after 31 Dec 2026
Visa applications open on the MyVISA online portal from 1 Dec 2026
Until 31 Dec Indians can enter visa-free for social visits of up to 30 days
Visa-free entry for Indians began in December 2023
Visa processing fees are non-refundable whether approved or rejected, or if policy or travel plans change
In September 2026 the High Commission of India in Kuala Lumpur warned Indians against taking up jobs while on tourist entry
